# Motion Text

Animated headline text from the Motion Gallery: wave letters, glitch, masked word reveal, 3D letter flip, typewriter and decode scramble. Text can come from a column or page item.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_MOTION_TEXT` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/motionText` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.1 |
| Based on | [Motion Gallery](https://github.com/MoatasemKamal/oracle-apex-components-library/blob/main/motion-gallery/index.html) (Original) |

For Typewriter and Scramble, separate several phrases with |, for example Welcome back|Your orders are ready. Screen readers get the plain text; users with reduced motion see it without animation.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | Text | sessionStateValue | yes |  | The text to animate. Static text, &ITEM. substitution or a column. |
| `effect` | Effect | selectList (`wave`, `glitch`, `reveal`, `flip`, `typewriter`, `scramble`) | yes | `wave` | The text animation. |
| `size` | Size | selectList (`small`, `large`, `extraLarge`) |  |  | Leave empty for the medium size. |
| `alignStart` | Align to Start | yesNo |  | `N` | Align the text to the start edge instead of centering it. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/motion-text/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_motion_text.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
